items.item_text: Must possess, upon hire, and maintain a valid CA noncommercial Class C License in accordance with the California (CA) Department of Motor Vehicles.
Forklift Certification 100
California Class C Driver's License 100
Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Pre-Placement Physical: Employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory physical examination.
Driving Record: The position is subject to the
California DMV "Pull Notice System"
and continued employment is contingent upon proof of a satisfactory driving record.
Experience and comprehensive knowledge of the care and treatment of a wide variety of plant life, including ability to identify horticultural pests and diseases.
Experience and comprehensive knowledge of proper methods for trimming trees and shrubs, mowing and edging lawns, and cultivating various plants.

At UCLA Facilities Management, we strive to “Be the Preferred Provider.” Join the team responsible for maintaining the 419-acre campus renowned as one of the most beautiful campuses in California with expansive lawns, brick-lined walkways, courtyards, plazas, gardens and athletic fields. As a team member, you will be responsible for providing a variety of outdoor maintenance services that helps maintain and preserve the health and beauty of the campus.
Ability to safely operate and maintain power-driven grounds maintenance equipment and various hand tools, including mowers, edgers, trimmers, shears, generators, renovators, and aerifiers.
Ability to prioritize, schedule, and coordinate work projects; direct and inspect the work of subordinates; and train and evaluate subordinates' effectiveness against job standards.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with peers, subordinates, supervisors, administrators, clients, visitors, vendors, and outside agencies.
Ability to perform effectively under conditions of fluctuating workloads, frequent interruptions and/or distractions, deadlines, and emergency repairs.
Oral communication skills sufficient to obtain and convey clear, concise, and grammatically correct information.
Skill in reading standard English text sufficient to follow written orders and carry out assignments.
Ability to write standard English text sufficient to prepare job orders and complete forms and purchase orders.
Skill in performing mathematical computations sufficient to calculate and implement the basic principles of irrigation.
Working knowledge of standard safe work practices.

Ability to perform physical grounds maintenance duties, including standing, walking, crawling, stooping, and lifting up to 50 lbs. independently or 80 lbs. with assistance. Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather and adverse conditions.
